question: Hypothyroidism is caused by which of the following anti-tubercular drug -
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: "Ethionamide" -> "inhibits thyroid hormone synthesis" -> "decreased thyroid hormone levels" -> "hypothyroidism" -> 85%
CHAIN: "PAS" -> "possible interference with thyroid function" -> "unclear impact on thyroid hormone levels" -> "hypothyroidism possible" -> 60%
CHAIN: "Cycloserine" -> "no known direct effect on thyroid function" -> "unlikely to cause hypothyroidism" -> "hypothyroidism not expected" -> 20%
CHAIN: "Pyrazinamide" -> "no established link to thyroid dysfunction" -> "unlikely to cause hypothyroidism" -> "hypothyroidism not expected" -> 15%
analysis: Ethionamide is known to cause hypothyroidism as it can inhibit the synthesis of thyroid hormones. Other options like PAS, Cycloserine, and Pyrazinamide are not commonly associated with hypothyroidism.
